title: Close 325-B0 and narrow the MIR 3.2.5 release contract
migration_impact: Keep public 3.2.3 as the sole predecessor of 3.2.5; retain 3.2.4/C31 as superseded-unpublished in its immutable release and closure records while preserving its exact ZIP in governed historical custody; close the admitted 325-B0 vertical slice; and defer generalized compatibility productization without creating 2.5.5 release authority or admitting 3.3 implementation.
release_note_impact: MIR 3.2.5 is explicitly narrowed to the unified research-cost release and its bounded research-cost compatibility proof/support slice. Generalized disposition, proof-authority, support-bundle, and broad Factorio 2.0 projection products move to a later release.

backport_disposition.factorio-2.1: apply as package-excluded release governance before essential 325-B1 and source freeze
backport_disposition.factorio-2.0: record exact shipped-feature dispositions only; create no 2.5.5 record, branch, candidate, or package authority

shipped_scope: Unified fixed, linear, exponential, and hybrid research costs.
Correct research-progress preservation, base-continuation coefficient anchoring, and six-significant-digit compatibility behavior.
Current Base, Space Age, governed ecosystem, and Ice dependency compatibility corrections.
The bounded 325-B0 research-cost disposition, typed proof assertion, privacy-safe support record, and Factorio 2.0 adapter disposition.
Release-specific migration, privacy, localization, performance, manual, protected, seal, publication, and public-byte proof.

deferred_scope.surface: Generalized all-stream and per-leaf terminal disposition product.
General-purpose public ProofAssertion and EcosystemProfile product authorities beyond release-specific evidence.
Universal support-bundle and remediation-catalog product beyond the bounded B0 artifact.
Broad 3.2.5-to-2.0 projection inventory beyond explicit dispositions for shipped features.

mandatory_release_specific_obligations: Essential 325-B1 default, numeric, parser, save/reload, ownership, realization, and shipped-feature target proof.
Exact Base, Space Age, upgrade, configuration-change, ecosystem, privacy, localization, performance, and manual evidence for frozen bytes.
Complete D1 freeze packet, candidate assignment only after source freeze, protected no-reuse qualification, seal, promotion, publication, and public-byte verification.

work_package_closure.release_authority_effect: none: 3.2.5 remains planned, C32 remains an unassigned floor, 2.5.5 authority remains absent, and 3.3 remains unadmitted
